title: Smooth height
summary: A wrapper that animates its own height to follow its content. Use it around lists and panels that gain or lose content, so the layout resizes in one move instead of snapping. Data table uses it already.

demos.title: A list that gains and loses rows
demos.note: Add and remove allergies. The rows change at once; the frame follows in one smooth move, so what sits below never snaps.

demos.title: Content that changes length
demos.note: Wrap any region whose content changes size: a filtered table, an expanding note, a form that reveals fields. It measures its content, so there is nothing to configure.
